verdict: Caution: lend to Tuticorin power contractors and equipment suppliers against state utility receivables, not to the proposed 1,600 MW coal IPP on merchant assumptions.
title: Tuticorin Power Generation & Distribution: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
**That is a construction and supply chain, not yet a generation cash flow** — so the near-term borrowers are EPC contractors, cable and switchgear suppliers, and substation civil works firms, not the plant owner. **Counterparty risk is the whole credit**: CARA flags collection periods over 400 days in FY25 (PY 351 days) at a peer exposed to weak discoms [10], so take assignment of receivables or escrow before sizing any exposure. ICRA's thermal methodology looks at cash collection trends, DSRA availability and working capital limit utilisation [8] — collect from customer the equivalent monthly data for any Tuticorin borrower. ## What has changed now
**Demand is fine; the local economy is not.** Tamil Nadu electricity demand is up 9.8% Apr-to-date versus India's 9.5% [D], but state GST collections are down 3.2% Apr-to-date against India's +6.1% [D]. **Bank credit is running far ahead of output** — India credit +22.9% YoY against activity +9.5% [D] — so pricing discipline matters more than volume. Peer results are strong but not local: Vedanta Power posted Rs 83 crore net profit and 14.5% margins in Q2 FY27 [5], with EBITDA up 122% to Rs 421 crore on Rs 2,908 crore revenue [6]; Adani Power has 95% of 18.33 GW tied to long-term PPAs [7]. Coal India's Q2 FY27 net profit rose 57% YoY to Rs 6,547 crore yet the stock fell 3% and target prices were cut [4] — fuel volume, not fuel price, is the swing factor. Structure against milestone bills with a 10–15% retention, escrow of utility payments, and a DSRA where ICRA's framework applies [8]. - **PPA unsigned or tariff renegotiated below Rs 8.75 per unit (quarterly)** -> decline the coal IPP proposal [1]. - **GST collections in Tamil Nadu staying negative (monthly)** -> cut unsecured exposure and raise margin [D].
